controls.objective: Identify and confirm residual vulnerabilities before release.
Maintain an explicit cybersecurity capability and governance context.
Retain trustworthy quality and security assurance evidence.
Plan adversarial testing for applicable AI attack techniques.
Measure maintainability, reliability, and security quality signals.
Retain evidence for architecture structure, boundaries, and drift.

procedures.objective: Identify and retain application entry points before active testing.
Test for privilege escalation across discovered authorization boundaries.
Execute the policy-pinned mobile test set when mobile surfaces are applicable.
Retain examination and test evidence for the scoped penetration-test procedure.
Assess applicable infrastructure against an approved CIS Benchmark release.
Execute the policy-pinned AI trustworthiness and adversarial test set.
